title: PSHS Main, Lapu-Lapu schools suspend Oct. 26 in-person classes

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Face-to-face classes for Oct. 26 are suspended at the Philippine Science High School (PSHS) Main Campus in Quezon City and several schools in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu. In an advisory, the PSHS Main Campus said classes would be suspended from October 26 to 27, 2026, due to “increasing reports of rising illness among students.” READ: PSHS-QC campus suspends in-person classes due to flu-like illness The campus added that classes would shift to an online learning setup on October 28 to 29, to limit viral transmission among students and teachers.
